subject: [PATCH 20/22] PM: hibernate: size the image from common memory

2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch modifies the hibernation image size calculation to only count free pages in zones on nodes that are marked as common memory, rather than all populated zones. This ensures that the hibernation image can be stored in common memory. The patch also separates the image metadata estimate from the page frame tracking, which is still calculated for all populated zones.
